description: Implementation of the WindowManagerConnector class, which manages interactions with a window manager service, including plugin initialization, display creation, and display info retrieval.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: Manages connection and communication with the window manager service, including plugin lifecycle and display management.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class handling window manager notifications, such as user inactivity events.

methods.name: WindowManagerConnector
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and logging creation.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by querying the window manager interface and registering for notifications.

methods.name: releasePlugin
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters from the window manager.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display with specified application instance ID, display name, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: isPluginInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether the plugin has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Retrieves display information such as XDG directory and Wayland display name based on environment and file checks.
